item.title: Show HN: WikiZipf – Guess the most frequent words of a Wikipedia article
item.summary: WikiZipf shows you the intro of a random Wikipedia article plus a cloud of 15 words. Five of them are the article's most frequent meaningful words — your job is to find them. There's also a reverse mode: you see the top-five words as a bar chart and pick the article from four titles. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49286176 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
